name: flight-recorder
description: Records interactions with AI coding assistants

commands.title: Flight Recorder: Print Assistant Log Path
Flight Recorder: Open Edit History Visualization

flightRecorder.debounceMs.description: Assistant-window debounce in milliseconds. Human edits are staged continuously until an assistant event is detected; after that, subsequent tracked changes stay attributed to the assistant until this idle timeout expires.

flightRecorder.activeIntegration.description: Selects which assistant integration Flight Recorder uses for recording and primary log discovery.

flightRecorder.claudeSource.description: For the Claude Code integration, choose whether Flight Recorder should prefer a configured hook log, the local transcript store, or auto-detect between them.

flightRecorder.claudeHookLogPath.description: For the Claude Code integration, path to a JSONL hook log file. Relative paths are resolved against the repository root.

flightRecorder.claudeConfigDir.description: Optional override for the Claude Code configuration directory. When empty, Flight Recorder uses CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR if set, otherwise ~/.claude.

flightRecorder.claudeMissingSourceBehavi.description: Controls what happens when the Claude Code integration cannot find a repo-specific transcript or hook log yet. 'wait' starts recording and attaches once the source appears; 'fail' aborts startup immediately.

flightRecorder.dryRun.description: Do not run git commit; only print what would be committed.

flightRecorder.forceAddGeneratedLogs.description: When true, force-stage generated .log and .chat-log artifacts so ignore rules do not block their dedicated commits.

flightRecorder.exportChatsOnStop.description: When true, automatically export chat session files into .chat-log and commit them as a separate shutdown commit.

enumDescriptions: Do not replace any absolute paths.
Replace only absolute paths that contain the repository root.
Replace all absolute paths found in content and commit messages.
flightRecorder.absolutePathHandling.description: Controls how absolute paths are handled during repository anonymization.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
